fact: ACTUALITE.CD reports the DRC's Guichet Unique de Création d'Entreprise (GUCE) presented a new website that proposes a legal form and tracks a file in real time, a mobile app lets entreprenants formalise in under 48 hours, and its acting director-general asked for further digital modernisation so all steps can be done online.

Congo Guardian reports the GUCE presented a new digital portal that proposes a legal form and tracks files in real time, a mobile app issues entreprenants an activity attestation in under 48 hours, and the acting director-general asked for more modernisation so all company-creation steps can be done online.
The article says the DRC continues digitising business procedures through the Guichet Unique de Création d'Entreprises.

The Ministry of Industry announced on 2025-05-20 the launch of phase two of the E-kazi platform, letting entrepreneurs assemble online the company file to send to the one-stop shop (GUCE), with protocols with Justice and Finance still being finalised before full service.

A World Bank representative said the one-stop company creation counter (GUCE) in Kinshasa can issue a commercial register (RCCM) entry in 48 hours, with fully online registration still only the stated goal.

Firms register at the physical Guichet unique de création d'entreprise (GUCE), and Projet TRANSFORME is defining requirements for online registration, which is targeted for 2027 and still precedes a tender for a provider.
